title: Liked but won’t keep ordering.
text: I did like the quick shipping and the items enclosed.  The two treats were high quality and the bandanna was darling but the other toy I never figured out what it was.  I think you freeze it.  So I might use this during the night while I have a hot flash in bed.  I am a member of the Barkbox  community and since I have 3 big dogs I’ll stick with them.  More treats and great toys.
label: positive
